text:
**Best overall: Jackery Solar Generator 1000 v2 with 200W panel, $699** (list $879)
- It has 1,070Wh, 1,500W AC output and an LiFePO4 battery, and charges in about 1 hour from a wall outlet.
- It has 4.5 stars from 1.4K reviews, and Amazon shows 2K+ bought in the past month.
- Talk of the House also named it their editor's choice. They say the 200W panel recharges it in roughly 6-8 hours of good sun, and that the panel ships separately from the power station.
- [Buy on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included)

**Other good picks by need**

| Need | Pick | Price | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Same size, strong alternatives | EcoFlow Delta 3 Classic with 220W panel | $699 | 1,024Wh, 1,800W AC, 4.6 stars (404 reviews) |
| | BLUETTI Elite 100 V2 with 200W panel | $699 | 1,024Wh, 1,800W AC, 4.5 stars (1.8K reviews) |
| Home backup (fridge, several appliances) | Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 with 2x200W panels | $1,399 | 2,042Wh, 2,200W AC, 4.6 stars |
| | BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 with 2x200W panels | $1,399 | 2,073Wh, 2,600W AC, 4.7 stars (950 reviews) |
| Longer outages or RV | BLUETTI Elite 300 with 2x200W panels | $1,599.99 | 3,014Wh, 2,400W AC, 4.7 stars |
| Tight budget | UDPOWER S1200 with 120W panel | $549.99 | 1,190Wh, but only 4.1 stars from 41 reviews |

- The first four rows are on [Amazon's solar generator listings](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels/s?k=solar+generator+with+solar+panels).
- The Elite 300 is on the same Amazon page.
- The UDPOWER is on [this Amazon page](https://www.amazon.com/solar-generator-panels-included/s?k=solar+generator+with+panels+included).

**If you have a Costco membership:** they list the [Jackery Explorer 1500 v2 with a solar panel for $899.99](https://www.costco.com/home-solar-power.html). It showed as out of stock at the Mountain View warehouse but available for delivery.

**Which to choose**
- For camping, short outages or a CPAP, the Jackery 1000 v2 is the safest choice.
- For running a fridge and more through longer outages, go with the 2,000Wh class (Jackery 2000 v2 or BLUETTI Elite 200 V2).
- EcoFlow is also Top Consumer Reviews' #1 pick, and they cite its 10ms UPS switchover and expandability ([source](https://www.topconsumerreviews.com/best-solar-generators/detailed-reviews.php)).
- Be careful with the very cheap 300W "solar generator" bundles, which have small batteries and small panels.

Prices come from the listings I was given and change often. Some of the Amazon results are sponsored, so check the product page before buying.
